comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

Di dog dem nuh joke, yuh hear!

Lawd! Di goat never do yuh nuttn!
Careful wid di animal dem, sah!

Respek! Yuh stop at Faith's Pen. Eat up and gwaan strong!
Ah di real ting dis! Jerk chicken, festival, roast yam — di road bless yuh!
